**Big: 1082 hits across 94 files. Four zones must not be renamed.**

| Zone | Files | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | 5 | Public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE values | 1 | 1 | Wire name |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | 37 | Already applied |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | 12 | Generated |

SQL column names inside repo query strings also stay. The column is still `account_id` until a real DB migration renames it. That is roughly 200 of the 425 repo hits.

Safe scope is local variables and params in `services/`. Decide on `lib/audit.js` too. Its field may feed log consumers.
